constraints: Preserve existing VM identity; initialize only a new VM.
Never publish filled EFI, XML, OSK, credentials, images or unredacted logs.
Resize only an idle VFIO-owned matching GPU pair with supported BAR and enough MMIO.
Do not invoke libvirt from its QEMU hook.
Verify guest VNC/SSH before removing the virtual display.
Keep QEMU AppleSMC and use -vsmccomp; expect one AppleSMC service.
Keep ProvideCustomSlide=true and host-managed GPU BAR settings at -1.
API success is not pixel correctness or full application qualification.

Driver-only downgrade must preserve current guest data; validate supported installer --payload, unmodified target manifests and truthful VERSION marker; full old-VDisk restoration is a separate recovery decision.

Apple ID troubleshooting preserves identity and keys; verify actual EFI, en0 built-in status, GUID NVRAM, expected Apple UUID derivation, network/time and authentication logs first. Scoped VMM sysctl patches are optional, excluded from default templates, and require reviewed fixed sources, full cold backup, target matches and same-version ocvalidate.
